We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Mechanical Engineering Technicians to join our team on a full-time permanent basis, supporting operations at our Parilla site in South Australia. 

As a valuable member of our team, this position will play a vital role in the success of our operations. If you are reliable, energetic and have a passion for agriculture we would love to hear from you.

The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, able to work both independently and as part of a team. Reporting directly to the Farm Workshop Manager you will be working in an outdoor farm environment. 

An attractive remuneration package between $70,000 - $90,000 is available to the right candidates. 

Duties include:

•	Identify, develop, and implement equipment upgrades, modifications, and new installs to reduce risk, improve capability, quality, and reliability, and lower operational costs.
•	Set up, operate, calibrate, and maintain machinery to ensure daily production requirements are met without negative impacts to the customer or business.
•	Conduct testing and evaluation of farm machinery and production equipment to ensure operational reliability.
•	Collect and analyse machine data, carrying out complex computations and preparing drawings.
•	Monitor equipment performance, identifying operational issues. 
•	Participate in quality improvement initiatives and projects.
•	Provide technical support and guidance to the operations team to ensure proper machine functionality.
•	Adjust machine controls whilst monitoring the production process to ensure quality production and minimal unplanned stops.
•	Assist the maintenance manager in diagnosing mechanical and hydraulic system faults.
•	Ensure all relevant safety objectives and legal requirements are observed for all work completed.
•	Conduct all duties in accordance with procedures as specified by the quality system to ensure that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and provisions.
•	All other requirements as directed to achieve business objectives.

Requirements:

•	Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent) OR at least 3 years of relevant experience.
•	Experience in mechanical services. 
•	Knowledge of tools, equipment, materials, methods, and practices of engine repair, mechanical and electrical systems, and maintenance.
•	Knowledge of standards and regulations associated with a mechanical workshop plant and equipment.
•	Ability to confidently diagnose faults on site and in the workshop.
•	Unrestricted Class C Drivers Licence (essential)
•	Cultural adaptability and a willingness to work with a diverse range of stakeholders. 
•	A willingness to be hands on and participate in a broad range of duties, a strong work ethic is essential.
•	Respect for others and pride in team’s performance.
•	Commitment to ongoing learning.
•	Commitment to delivering team goals and the drive to be successful.

This position will require weekend and night work in line with production demands.

Please visit www.zerellafresh.com.au for more information about the company.

To apply for this position please send an email to hr@zerella.com.au including the title of the position and location you are applying for in the email subject line. Please include a cover letter and up to date resume in your application.

Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd is a leading Australian meat processing, wholesale and export company specialising in the sourcing, processing, packaging and distribution of premium halal-certified meat products. The company supplies a wide range of fresh and frozen beef, lamb, mutton, goat and poultry products to domestic wholesalers, retailers, food service providers and international export markets. With a strong reputation for quality, reliability and strict adherence to Australian food safety and halal certification standards, Hilal Meat fosters a collaborative, values-driven workplace culture that emphasises integrity, continuous improvement, team support and a commitment to excellence in everything we do.
About the Position:
The Accountant (General) plays a vital role in supporting the financial integrity and strategic growth of Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd. Reporting to senior management, this position is responsible for managing core financial operations, delivering accurate reporting and analysis, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing insightful financial guidance to support informed business decisions in a dynamic meat processing and export environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Preparing and analysing financial statements including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements to provide a comprehensive view of the company’s financial performance.

Strong technical skills in financial reporting, budgeting, tax compliance, auditing, record-keeping and financial analysis, with proficiency in relevant accounting software.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, strong communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.

With offices in Newcastle, Wollongong, Gold Coast, and Rockhampton, SENPOS combines home-grown software and hardware development with exceptional local support to streamline operations, enhance customer engagement, and drive business profitability. Reporting to Strategy and Ops, the role plans, coordinates, and delivers multiple concurrent projects, manages system integrations, and ensures a smooth transition from initiation through to go-live and handover to Support, all within agreed timeframes and budgets.

Lead and manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously, from initiation through to post go-live review.

Develop and maintain project plans and communication logs.
Coordinate across internal teams, including implementations, development, support, product, and training, to ensure deliverables meet quality standards.

Job description

Fetch Recruitment is an Australian owned recruitment consultancy, delivering long term benefits to both our candidates and clients within the built environment. At Fetch, we passionate about empowering people to take charge of their careers and realize their potential, regardless of whether this is the candidates we partner with or colleagues in our team. We are looking for a highly driven and polished Principal Recruitment Consultant committed to building a lasting network of candidates and clients.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Due to growth and a high client demand, we have a couple of opportunities for experienced Principal Recruitment Consultant to join the team. We have opportunities within the engineering and the local government divisions. The role will include, but not limited to, the following responsibilities:
Developing growth strategies and plans
Managing and retaining relationships with existing clients
Increasing client base through canvass calling, use of marketing networking and lead generation
Identifying and mapping business strengths and customer needs
Strive to achieve maximum revenue for Fetch through effective objection handling and negotiation in line with company policy

ABOUT YOU
You may already be a Recruitment Consultant looking for a new exciting challenge or a hungry Senior Recruitment Consultant looking to prove your abilities.
Demonstrated experience working within the construction, engineering or local government sectors. Previous experience managing a 360 desk and developing new business Leadership qualities is desired but not essential.
You will be required to have 3+ years experience in business to business sales. It is important you have excellent phone sales skills and experience interacting and building relationships with businesses and corporations.

WHY FETCH?

We are big on celebrating success and have a huge focus on our culture, just to list a few benefits:
Work alongside Industry leaders within Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure and Labour Hire Recruitment
Global PSA Clients
LinkedIn Recruiter License
Highflyers Club
Quarterly Team Building
Networking functions
Yearly team trips away
Access to 6 extra annual leave days
End of month events
Quarterly awards
Microsoft Surface Pro & iPhone
Flexible working from home policy
Modern office in central Southbank location, walking distance from Flinders St Station


We will offer you fast development, support, strong internal and external training and various opportunities. You will benefit from a high salary and a very rewarding commission structure but for that we are looking for the best successful and proven sales professionals.

If you are looking for an opportunity to progress your career within a successful expanding agency, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Please check us out at www.fetchrecruitment.com.au

Apply through this website

result.description: Prodoz International Pty Ltd   About the Role   We are seeking an experienced  Agricultural Technician  to join our growing team based in Mildura, Victoria.  This role will support growers through the implementation of crop production programs, field trials and agricultural technologies. Working closely with customers, agronomists, researchers and management, you will provide practical technical support, monitor product performance and assist with the testing and continuous improvement of innovative agricultural solutions.   Key Responsibilities    Provide technical support to growers in relation to crop production, soil management and agricultural technologies.  Install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot agricultural technology and equipment used in crop production.  Conduct field trials and product evaluations to assess the performance of fertilisers, soil conditioners, bio-stimulants and horticultural products.  Collect, record and analyse field data, preparing technical reports and recommendations.  Monitor crop performance, soil conditions and field trial outcomes.  Assist with research, testing and product development activities.  Diagnose technical issues and recommend practical solutions to improve crop performance.  Support the implementation of precision agriculture and other advanced farming technologies.  Liaise with growers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to deliver technical advice and ongoing support.  Conduct product demonstrations and provide technical guidance to customers.  Maintain accurate records of field activities, trial results and service reports.  Travel throughout the region to visit customers and trial sites as required.    Skills and Experience   To be successful in this role, you will have:   Sound knowledge of crop production systems, soil management and sustainable farming practices.  Experience conducting field trials, collecting technical data and preparing reports.  Experience using or supporting agricultural technologies, precision agriculture systems or related agricultural equipment.  Strong diagnostic, analytical and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and relationship management skills.  Well-developed organisational skills and the ability to work independently.  Proficiency using computer software for technical reporting and data management.    What We Offer    Company vehicle, laptop and mobile phone.  Ongoing training and professional development.  Opportunity to work with innovative agricultural technologies and industry-leading products.  Supportive team environment with opportunities for long-term career development.   If you have a passion for agriculture, enjoy solving technical challenges and want to work with innovative farming solutions, we encourage you to apply.  About Company    PRODOZ is an Australian agribusiness specialising in innovative crop, soil and agricultural technology solutions. Working with leading global partners, we develop and supply products and technical services that help growers improve crop performance, soil health and sustainable farming practices across Australia and international markets.
